name: 91502 · Burbank, CA
findings: ZIP 91502 (Burbank) has 93 nonprofit organizations. 42 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 36 organizations.
Health care organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 91502 (Burbank) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
76% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 91502 (Burbank) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.8 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 73% of all organizations here have no identified type.
